component.name: CapsuleCraft
component.summary: Offline knowledge base stored as a folder of .eml files

description.p: CapsuleCraft stores every note as a standards-compliant email (.eml) file in a folder you own. No database, no account, no network required.
Native egui shell, built-in FAQ, Markdown blocks, attachments, search, and an optional IMAP mailbox sync.
